title: Staff Software Engineer - Backend
description: P-1328 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. The AI Governance team extends Unity Catalog's governance model to AI assets including models, agents, skills, MCP servers, and the tools they use. You will build platform capabilities that enable organizations to manage AI assets with familiar governance controls, route AI requests through a central control plane with access policies and usage limits, and provide visibility into AI activity for monitoring and auditing. The Impact You Will Have Design and implement scalable distributed systems that govern AI assets, runtime access, and usage across the Databricks platform Own complex technical projects end-to-end, from architecture and design through production deployment and operational excellence Define technical strategy and drive architectural decisions for AI governance capabilities Build reliable services and APIs that handle sensitive data with strong security and compliance requirements Collaborate across engineering teams to integrate governance controls into the broader platform Mentor senior engineers and elevate engineering practices across the organization What We Look For 8+ years of software engineering experience Experience architecting and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments Strong programming skills in languages including Java, Scala, or Go Experience building cloud-native services and working with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or GCP Experience with software security and systems that handle sensitive data Ability to drive technical direction and influence engineering roadmaps through strong technical judgment and communication B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.
